pairs: And he said to his disciples:
Impossibile est ut non veniant scandala:
“It is impossible for scandals not to occur.
væ autem illi per quem veniunt.
But woe to him through whom they come!
Utilius est illi si lapis molaris imponatur circa collum ejus,
It would be better for him if a millstone were placed around his neck and he were thrown into the sea,
et projiciatur in mare quam ut scandalizet unum de pusillis istis.
than to lead astray one of these little ones.
Si peccaverit in te frater tuus,
If your brother has sinned against you,
Et si septies in die peccaverit in te,
And if he has sinned against you seven times a day,
et septies in die conversus fuerit ad te,
and seven times a day has turned back to you,
And the Apostles said to the Lord,
Si habueritis fidem sicut granum sinapis,
“If you have faith like a grain of mustard seed,
you may say to this mulberry tree,
and be transplanted into the sea.’
Quis autem vestrum habens servum arantem aut pascentem,
But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, would say to him,
qui regresso de agro dicat illi:
as he was returning from the field,
et non dicat ei: Para quod cœnem,
and would not say to him:
et ministra mihi donec manducem, et bibam,
gird yourself and minister to me, while I eat and drink;
et post hæc tu manducabis, et bibes?
and after these things, you shall eat and drink?’
Would he be grateful to that servant,
for doing what he commanded him to do?
Sic et vos cum feceritis omnia quæ præcepta sunt vobis,
when you have done all these things that have been taught to you,
We have done what we should have done.’”
while he was traveling to Jerusalem,
transibat per mediam Samariam et Galilæam.
he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
And as he was entering a certain town,
and they stood at a distance.
And they lifted up their voice, saying,
when he saw that he was cleansed,
magnifying God with a loud voice.
et cecidit in faciem ante pedes ejus,
And he fell face down before his feet,
And this one was a Samaritan.
And so where are the nine?
Was no one found who would return
quia fides tua te salvum fecit.
For your faith has saved you.”
Then he was questioned by the Pharisees:
“When does the kingdom of God arrive?”
Non venit regnum Dei cum observatione:
And so, they will not say,
Ecce enim regnum Dei intra vos est.
For behold, the kingdom of God is within you.”
And he said to his disciples:
Venient dies quando desideretis videre unum diem Filii hominis,
“The time will come when you will desire to see one day of the Son of man,
and you will not see it.
And they will say to you,
Do not choose to go out, and do not follow them.
nam, sicut fulgur coruscans de sub cælo in ea quæ sub cælo sunt, fulget:
For just as lightning flashes from under heaven and shines to whatever is under heaven,
ita erit Filius hominis in die sua.
so also will the Son of man be in his day.
Primum autem oportet illum multa pati,
But first he must suffer many things
and be rejected by this generation.
Et sicut factum est in diebus Noë,
And just as it happened in the days of Noah,
ita erit et in diebus Filii hominis:
so also will it be in the days of the Son of man.
uxores ducebant et dabantur ad nuptias,
they were taking wives and being given in marriage,
usque in diem, qua intravit Noë in arcam:
even until the day that Noah entered the ark.
et venit diluvium, et perdidit omnes.
And the flood came and destroyed them all.
Similiter sicut factum est in diebus Lot:
It shall be similar to what happened in the days of Lot.
qua die autem exiit Lot a Sodomis,
on the day that Lot departed from Sodom,
it rained fire and brimstone from heaven,
secundum hæc erit qua die Filius hominis revelabitur.
According to these things, so shall it be in the day when the Son of man will be revealed.
In illa hora, qui fuerit in tecto,
In that hour, whoever will be on the rooftop,
with his goods in the house,
ne descendat tollere illa: et qui in agro,
let him not descend to take them. And whoever will be in the field,
similarly, let him not turn back.
Quicumque quæsierit animam suam salvam facere,
Whoever has sought to save his life,
will bring it back to life.
In illa nocte erunt duo in lecto uno:
in that night, there will be two in one bed.
and the other will be left behind.
Two will be at the grindstone together.
and the other will be left behind.
Two will be in the field.
and the other will be left behind.”
the eagles shall be gathered together.”
